summary:
百事EPS超預期、營收年增8.5%，零食與飲料組合展現訂價韌性。
• EPS 1.61美元，超越預期1.55美元，正向驚喜3.75%
• 營收194.4億美元，年增8.5%維持穩健
• Frito-Lay零食事業提供高利潤與抗景氣特性
• 多元品牌組合與全球通路分散單一市場風險
ai_view:
訊號正向：8.5%營收年增與EPS超標顯示訂價力仍在、量價組合改善，符合消費必需股的防禦特性。短中期股價受穩定股利與盈餘能見度支撐，22.79倍本益比合理。中期觀察點為量能是否隨漲價放緩及健康化趨勢衝擊。追蹤指標：有機營收成長拆解量價、北美零食與飲料量能、毛利率走勢、新興市場表現，以及全年每股盈餘指引。

需留意：GLP-1減重藥趨勢長期可能影響零食與含糖飲料需求；原物料與包裝成本波動壓縮毛利；消費者對漲價反彈導致量能下滑

summary_en:
PepsiCo beat EPS with 8.5% revenue growth, as its snacks-and-beverage mix showed pricing resilience.
• EPS of $1.61 beat the $1.55 estimate, a 3.75% positive surprise
• Revenue of $19.44B grew 8.5%, holding steady
• Frito-Lay snacks provide high margins and recession resistance
• Diversified brand portfolio and global channels spread single-market risk

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: 8.5% revenue growth and an EPS beat show intact pricing power and improving volume/price mix, consistent with a consumer-staples defensive profile. Near to mid-term, the stock is supported by a stable dividend and earnings visibility, with a reasonable 22.79x P/E. Mid-term, watch whether volumes soften as pricing laps and health trends bite. Track: organic revenue volume/price split, North America snacks and beverage volumes, gross margin trend, emerging-market performance, and full-year EPS guidance.

Watch：GLP-1 weight-loss drug trends may pressure snack and sugary-drink demand long term; Commodity and packaging cost volatility compress gross margin; Consumer pushback on price increases could weigh on volumes
